documents.title: Integrate AI into your Teaching
documents.summary: The campus teaching center's page argues that faculty and students should engage with generative AI, lists benefits and ethical cautions (accuracy, privacy, access), and advises instructors to write specific syllabus language rather than a blanket policy. It also proposes assignment redesigns and points to college-level sample statements.
documents.stance_why: The page sets no campus rule on AI use. It says "The knee-jerk response is to add a blanket AI policy to your syllabus, but this is not advised" and tells instructors to "Define clear boundaries for AI use in course assignments and assessments", which hands the decision to instructors.
